Subject: Trillium pilot - early unwind inquiry

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the pilot support — we’ve had some unexpected budget reforecasting and the execs are asking us to pause the paid pilot effective early December. Before we do anything, procurement asked me to confirm Redwood's standard early termination / ramp language and whether there’s flexibility for a shorter notice window and proration.

Key asks from my side:
- Is there a minimal notice period we need to give (your SOW references a 90-day ramp)?
- If we stop after Dec 15, what credit or proration should we expect?
- Can we negotiate an opt-out for the remainder of the pilot with a one-time grace window?

We’re trying to move quickly; would appreciate options you can sign off on from Redwood leadership. I’ve attached a short note with our internal timeline.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Head of Product Ops, Trillium Labs
sarah.liu@trilliumlabs.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trillium pilot - early unwind inquiry

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads-up and the attachment. I’m looping in Marissa (revenue ops) to scope options from contract and finance side. Quick summary of what we normally do and a proposed alternative so we can move fast: 

Standard (per SOW): 90-day ramp/notice; unused committed months are not automatically credited (depends on term and commitment schedule).
Proposed one-time option for pilots (to expedite): 60-day staged unwind: 30-day run-out where we keep capacity live but throttle, followed by a 30-day notice/transition window; prorated credit on remaining committed capacity at 50%.

If that sounds acceptable to Trillium, we’ll need an exec approval on the 50% credit and shortened notice on our side. Marissa — can you run the numbers and flag any revenue recognition / contractual risk? I’ve attached a quick proposed schedule (proposed_unwind_schedule.xlsx).

Priyom
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Priyom / Vivek — quick calc + recommendation for the Trillium request.

Summary of numbers (attached calcs_trillium_credits.csv):
- Remaining committed term if they exit on Dec 15: 4.5 months equivalent of committed capacity.
- Proposed 50% proration credit => credit = 2.25 months worth of committed USD (applied as account credit).
- Impact to ARR/recognition: we’ll need to reverse recognized revenue for the credited months; finance notes this will affect Q4 deferred revenue by ~ $120k.

Recommendation (commercial): Approve one-time 60-day staged unwind as Priyom outlined; offer 50% prorated credit applied as account credit. Require Trillium sign the SOW amendment and execute DocuSign within 7 business days.

Open asks for approval: Vivek (finance) — confirm accounting treatment is acceptable and whether any other controls required. Laura — need your sign-off for the non-standard credit and shortened notice.

Date: 2026-11-17T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Exec approval request — Trillium pilot early unwind (deal TRI-4531)

Laura — requesting exec approval for a one-time commercial exception on the Trillium pilot:

Requested deviations from standard SOW:
- Shorten notice / ramp from 90 days to 60 days staged unwind (30-day run-out + 30-day transition).
- Offer 50% prorated credit for any unused committed months (applied as account credit).
- One-time opt-out clause: Trillium may terminate the pilot once during the commitment window if executed before Dec 20.

Rationale: Trillium is a strategic small enterprise account with potential renewal next year. Offering a pragmatic, time-boxed compromise preserves the relationship and reduces churn risk. Finance has estimated a $120k deferred revenue impact for Q4 if approved (Marissa attached calcs).

Controls suggested if approved:
- SOW amendment with explicit effective dates and credit mechanics (we will not provide cash refunds; credit only).
- DocuSign execution within 7 business days and RevOps hold on provisioning until signed.
- CS handoff checklist to capture knowledge transfer and close-loop metrics.

Please reply with sign-off or proposed changes. If you’d prefer, I can schedule a 15m sync.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Trillium pilot early unwind (deal TRI-4531)

Priyom — I approve the one-time exception with the following conditions:

1) Credit cap: 50% prorated credit is acceptable up to a maximum $150k gross credit.
2) Sign-off: SOW amendment must be executed via DocuSign and countersigned by Trillium legal within 7 business days. No operational changes until executed.
3) Revenue: Finance (Vivek) to confirm deferral and update forecast; Marissa to document journal entries required.
4) One-time opt-out: limit to a single invocation and the opt-out must be exercised by Dec 20.
5) CS: Customer Success to schedule a 30/60/90 handoff plan during the transition window; attach CS acceptance note to the amendment.

Once those are in place, proceed and update the HubSpot deal with the amended terms and the DocuSign link. Please copy me on the final executed SOW.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
